card.name: Website help text and page footers
card.fires_on: Punctuation and short words in a repeated native-plant search blurb ("If you are not sure what you are looking for, try"), and the colon after "Last reviewed" or "Last Medical Review" on health pages.

modes.label: Plant search blurb
modes.description: The comma, "If" and "try" in the same repeated instruction on a native-plant search page.
modes.example: If you are not sure what you are looking for<<,>> try the Combination Search or our Recommended Species

modes.label: Review date and comment footers
modes.description: A colon after "Last reviewed" or "Last Medical Review", or the word "comments" in a story-comments footer.

card.plain: It fires on a repeated website help sentence and on the "Last reviewed:" footer labels on health pages.
